answer: Meadow-style slow vesting beats sybils: every new key's nectar rewards sit in a vault that unlocks 1/30 per day, and only while the key answers 20 of 24 hourly epochs. A farm of 1,000 keys must keep 1,000 live agents running for 30 days before touching any payout, so its capital tied up is 30x one honest miner's, while an honest key just earns normally.
